units.obligation_text: Should the license denial be upheld, the applicant may again apply for a license 1 year from the date of the final order denying the application, unless the order provides otherwise.
units.action_summary: If denial is upheld, the applicant may reapply after 1 year unless the order states otherwise.

units.obligation_text: An applicant who submitted a timely appeal of a third pre-license inspection as described in § 2.3(c), and whose appeal results in the denial of the license application, may request an expedited hearing if the applicant held a valid license when he or she submitted the license application that has been denied and the Deputy Administrator received such license application no fewer than 90 days prior to the expiration of the valid license.
units.action_summary: Applicants meeting specific criteria (timely appeal, previously held valid license, and application received 90+ days prior to expiration) may request an expedited hearing after denial.

units.obligation_text: The applicant must submit the request for an expedited hearing within 30 days of receiving notice from the Deputy Administrator that the license application has been denied;
units.action_summary: To obtain an expedited hearing, the applicant must request it within 30 days of denial notice.

units.obligation_text: The administrative law judge shall set the expedited hearing so that it occurs within 30 days of receiving a timely request for expedited hearing as described in paragraph (b)(2)(i) of this section;
units.action_summary: The ALJ must schedule the expedited hearing to occur within 30 days of receiving a timely request.

units.obligation_text: The administrative law judge must issue an initial decision no later than 30 days after the expedited hearing.
units.action_summary: The ALJ must issue an initial decision within 30 days after the expedited hearing.

units.obligation_text: The applicant’s license will remain valid until the administrative law judge issues his or her initial decision. Should the administrative law judge’s initial decision affirm the denial of the license application, the applicant’s license shall terminate immediately.
units.action_summary: Applicant's license remains valid during expedited proceedings until the ALJ's decision; if denial is affirmed, the license terminates immediately.

units.obligation_text: No partnership, firm, corporation, or other legal entity in which a person whose license application has been denied has a substantial interest, financial or otherwise, will be licensed within 1 year of the license denial.
units.actor: partnerships/firms/corporations/other entities with substantial interest by denied applicant
units.action_summary: Entities in which a denied applicant has substantial interest are prohibited from being licensed for 1 year after denial.

units.obligation_text: No license will be issued under circumstances that the Administrator determines would circumvent any order, stipulation, or settlement agreement suspending, revoking, terminating, or denying a license or disqualifying a person from engaging in activities under the Act.
units.action_summary: Licenses will not be issued in circumstances that the Administrator determines would circumvent prior enforcement orders or disqualifications.

units.obligation_text: A license may be terminated at any time for any reason that a license application may be denied pursuant to § 2.11 after a hearing in accordance with the applicable rules of practice.
units.action_summary: A license may be terminated after a hearing for any reason a license application could be denied under §2.11.

units.obligation_text: Except as otherwise provided in § 2.3(c), any licensee or registrant may appeal all or part of the inspection findings in an inspection report to the Deputy Administrator. To appeal, the licensee or registrant must send a written statement contesting the inspection finding(s) and include any documentation or other information in support of the appeal. To receive consideration, the appeal must be received by the Deputy Administrator within 21 days of the date the licensee or registrant received the inspection report that is the subject of the appeal.
units.action_summary: Licensees/registrants may appeal inspection findings by sending a written statement with supporting documentation; appeals must be received within 21 days to be considered.

units.obligation_text: APHIS will publish on its website lists of research facilities registered in accordance with the provisions of this subpart. The lists may be obtained upon request from the Deputy Administrator.
units.action_summary: APHIS will publish lists of registered research facilities online; lists can also be obtained by request from the Deputy Administrator.

units.obligation_text: APHIS will publish on its website lists of persons licensed or registered in accordance with the provisions of this part. The lists may also be obtained upon request from the Deputy Administrator.
units.action_summary: APHIS will publish lists of licensed/registered persons online; lists are obtainable by request from the Deputy Administrator.

units.obligation_text: Potable water must be continually available to the dogs, unless restricted by the attending veterinarian.
units.actor: dealer, exhibitor, research facility (those responsible for dogs)
units.action_summary: Dogs must have continuous access to potable water, unless the attending veterinarian restricts access.

units.obligation_text: If potable water is not continually available to the cats, it must be offered to the cats as often as necessary to ensure their health and well-being, but not less than twice daily for at least 1 hour each time, unless restricted by the attending veterinarian.
units.actor: dealer, exhibitor, research facility (those responsible for cats)
units.action_summary: If cats do not have continuous water access, water must be offered as needed but at least twice daily for one hour each, unless attending veterinarian restricts.

units.obligation_text: Not less than twice daily for at least 1 hour each time
units.action_summary: Minimum requirement: cats must be offered water at least twice daily for at least one hour each time when continuous access is not provided.

units.obligation_text: Water receptacles must be kept clean and sanitized in accordance with § 3.11(b) and before being used to water a different dog or cat or social grouping of dogs or cats.
units.action_summary: Water receptacles must be cleaned and sanitized per §3.11(b) and before being reused for different animals or groups.

units.obligation_text: Each dealer, exhibitor, and research facility must follow an appropriate program of veterinary care for dogs that is developed, documented in writing, and signed by the attending veterinarian. Dealers, exhibitors, and research facilities must keep and maintain the written program and make it available for APHIS inspection.
units.action_summary: Dealers/exhibitors/research facilities must have a written veterinary care program signed by the attending veterinarian and keep it available for APHIS inspection.

units.obligation_text: Regularly scheduled visits, not less than once every 12 months, by the attending veterinarian to all premises where animals are kept, to assess and ensure the adequacy of veterinary care and other aspects of animal care and use;
units.action_summary: Attending veterinarian must visit all premises at least once every 12 months to assess veterinary care and animal care/use.
units.modal_raw: not less than once every 12 months / must

units.obligation_text: A complete physical examination from head to tail of each dog by the attending veterinarian not less than once every 12 months;
units.action_summary: Each dog must receive a complete physical exam by the attending veterinarian at least annually.
units.modal_raw: not less than once every 12 months / must

units.obligation_text: Vaccinations for contagious and deadly diseases of dogs (including rabies, parvovirus and distemper) and sampling and treatment of parasites and other pests (including fleas, worms, coccidia, giardia, and heartworm) in accordance with a schedule approved by the attending veterinarian, unless otherwise required by a research protocol approved by the Committee at research facilities;
units.actor: dealers, exhibitors, research facilities; attending veterinarian (approves schedule)
units.action_summary: Vaccinations and parasite control must be done per a schedule approved by the attending veterinarian, except as modified by approved research protocols.

units.obligation_text: Preventative care and treatment to ensure healthy and unmatted hair coats, properly trimmed nails, and clean and healthy eyes, ears, skin, and teeth, unless otherwise required by a research protocol approved by the Committee at research facilities.
units.action_summary: Must provide preventative care to maintain dogs' coats, nails, and general hygiene, except as required otherwise by approved research protocols.

units.obligation_text: Dealers, exhibitors, and research facilities must keep copies of medical records for dogs and make the records available for APHIS inspection.
units.action_summary: These entities must maintain medical records for dogs and make them available for APHIS inspection.

units.obligation_text: The identity of the animal, including identifying marks, tattoos, or tags on the animal and the animal’s breed, sex, and age; Provided, however, that routine husbandry, such as vaccinations, preventive medical procedures, or treatments, performed on all animals in a group (or herd), may be kept on a single record;
units.action_summary: Records must include animal identity details; routine group husbandry entries may be recorded on a single group record.

units.obligation_text: Provided, however, that routine husbandry ... may be kept on a single record;
units.action_summary: Exception: routine husbandry for groups may be maintained on a single record rather than individual records.

units.obligation_text: If a problem is identified (such as a disease, injury, or illness), the date and a description of the problem, examination findings, test results, plan for treatment and care, and treatment procedures performed, when appropriate;
units.actor: dealers, exhibitors, research facilities / attending veterinarian (documentation)
units.action_summary: If a problem is identified, records must include date/description, exam findings, test results, treatment plan, and treatments performed as appropriate.

units.obligation_text: The names of all vaccines and treatments administered and the dates of administration;
units.action_summary: Records must list all vaccines and treatments given and the dates administered.

units.obligation_text: The dates and findings/results of all screening, routine, or other required or recommended test or examination.
units.action_summary: Records must include dates and results/findings of all required or recommended tests and examinations.

units.obligation_text: The lists may be obtained upon request from the Deputy Administrator.
units.action_summary: Interested parties may request lists of registered research facilities from the Deputy Administrator.

units.obligation_text: The lists may also be obtained upon request from the Deputy Administrator.
units.action_summary: Interested parties may request lists of licensed or registered persons from the Deputy Administrator.

title: Animal Welfare; Amendments to Licensing Provisions and to Requirements for Dogs
Administrative Changes to the Regulations Governing the National Veterinary Accreditation Program

units.obligation_text: The veterinarian is licensed to practice veterinary medicine in the State in which the veterinarian wishes to perform accredited duties.
units.action_summary: Be licensed in the State where they intend to perform accredited duties.

units.obligation_text: An unlicensed veterinarian is legally able to practice veterinary medicine in a State provided that the veterinarian is granted written authorization by that State’s veterinary licensing authority
units.action_summary: Unlicensed veterinarians may practice in a State if granted written authorization by the State licensing authority.

units.obligation_text: but such authorization may limit practice to specific geographical areas and activities within the State.
units.actor: the State's veterinary licensing authority / the authorization
units.action_summary: The written authorization may restrict the geographical areas and activities in which the veterinarian may practice within the State.

units.obligation_text: APHIS will confirm the licensing or legal status of the applicant by contacting the State board of veterinary medical examiners or any similar State organization that maintains records of veterinarians licensed or otherwise legally able to practice in a State;
units.action_summary: APHIS must verify an applicant's licensing or legal status by contacting the appropriate State board or similar organization.

units.obligation_text: An accredited veterinarian may not perform accredited duties in a State in which the accredited veterinarian is not licensed or in possession of a document from the State’s veterinary licensing authority indicating that he or she is legally able to practice veterinary medicine in that State without a license.
units.action_summary: Accredited veterinarians are prohibited from performing accredited duties in a State where they are neither licensed nor possess documentation authorizing practice without a license.

title: Evaluation and Recognition of the Animal Health Status of Compartments

units.obligation_text: Those designated systems of records which are exempt from the requirements of sections (c)(3); (d); (e)(1); (e)(4)(G), (H), (I); and (f) of the Privacy Act, 5 U.S.C. 552a, include FRTIB–13, Fraud and Forgery Records.
units.action_summary: Identifies FRTIB-13 system of records as exempt from specified Privacy Act requirements.

units.obligation_text: The representative of the national government(s) of any country or countries who has the authority to make such a request may request that APHIS recognize the animal health status of a region or a compartment.
units.actor: the representative of the national government(s)
units.action_summary: Permits an authorized national government representative to request APHIS recognition of a region's or compartment's animal health status.

units.obligation_text: Such requests must be made in English and must be sent to the Administrator, c/o Strategy and Policy, VS, APHIS, 4700 River Road, Unit 38, Riverdale, MD 20737–1231.
units.actor: the representative of the national government(s) submitting the request
units.action_summary: Requires requests to be in English and sent to the specified APHIS address.

units.obligation_text: Requests for recognition of the animal health status of a region, other than requests submitted in accordance with paragraph (c) of this section, must include, in English, the following information about the region.
units.action_summary: Requires that requests for regional recognition include specified information in English.

units.obligation_text: Scope of the evaluation being requested.
units.action_summary: Provide the scope of the requested evaluation.

units.obligation_text: Veterinary control and oversight.
units.action_summary: Provide information on veterinary control and oversight.

units.obligation_text: Disease history and vaccination practices.
units.action_summary: Provide disease history and vaccination practice information.

units.obligation_text: Livestock demographics and traceability.
units.action_summary: Provide livestock demographics and traceability information.

units.obligation_text: Epidemiological separation from potential sources of infection.
units.action_summary: Provide information on epidemiological separation from infection sources.

units.obligation_text: Surveillance.
units.action_summary: Provide surveillance information.

units.obligation_text: Diagnostic laboratory capabilities.
units.action_summary: Provide information on diagnostic laboratory capabilities.

units.obligation_text: Emergency preparedness and response.
units.action_summary: Provide emergency preparedness and response information.

units.obligation_text: For a region to be considered historically free of a disease, the disease must not have been reported in domestic livestock for at least the past 25 years and must not have been reported in wildlife for at least the past 10 years.
units.actor: the region (for consideration as historically free)
units.action_summary: Requires no reported occurrence of the disease in domestic livestock for 25 years and wildlife for 10 years to be considered historically free.

units.obligation_text: Requests for recognition that a region is historically free of a disease based on the amount of time that has elapsed since the disease last occurred in a region, if it has ever occurred, must include, in English, the following information about the region.
units.action_summary: Requires specific information in English for requests to recognize a region as historically free.

units.obligation_text: Scope of the evaluation being requested.
units.action_summary: Provide the scope of the historical-free evaluation requested.

units.obligation_text: Veterinary control and oversight.
units.action_summary: Provide veterinary control and oversight information for the historically free request.

units.obligation_text: Disease history and vaccination practices.
units.action_summary: Provide disease history and vaccination practices for the historically free request.

units.obligation_text: Disease notification.
units.action_summary: Provide disease notification information.

units.obligation_text: Disease detection.
units.action_summary: Provide disease detection information.

units.obligation_text: Barriers to disease introduction.
units.action_summary: Provide information on barriers to disease introduction.

units.obligation_text: Requests for recognition of the animal health status of a compartment must include, in English, the following information about the compartment.
units.action_summary: Requires specific information in English for requests to recognize a compartment's animal health status.

units.obligation_text: Scope of the evaluation being requested.
units.action_summary: Provide the scope of the compartment evaluation requested.

units.obligation_text: Veterinary control and oversight of the compartment.
units.action_summary: Provide information on veterinary control and oversight specific to the compartment.

units.obligation_text: Disease history and vaccination practices.
units.action_summary: Provide disease history and vaccination practices for the compartment.

units.obligation_text: Livestock or poultry commodity movement and traceability.
units.action_summary: Provide information on commodity movement and traceability into, within, and out of the compartment.

units.obligation_text: Epidemiologic separation of the compartment from potential sources of infection.
units.action_summary: Provide information on epidemiologic separation of the compartment from infection sources.

units.obligation_text: Surveillance.
units.action_summary: Provide surveillance information for the compartment.

units.obligation_text: Diagnostic laboratory capabilities.
units.action_summary: Provide diagnostic laboratory capability information for the compartment.

units.obligation_text: Emergency preparedness and response.
units.action_summary: Provide emergency preparedness and response information for the compartment.

units.obligation_text: If, after review and evaluation of the information submitted in accordance with paragraph (b), (c), or (d) of this section, APHIS believes the request can be safely granted, APHIS will indicate its intent and make its evaluation available for public comment through a document published in the Federal Register.
units.action_summary: Requires APHIS to indicate intent and publish its evaluation for public comment if it believes the request can be safely granted.

units.obligation_text: APHIS will provide a period of time during which the public may comment on its evaluation.
units.action_summary: APHIS must provide a comment period for the public on its evaluation.

units.obligation_text: During the comment period, the public may comment on its evaluation.
units.action_summary: Permits the public to submit comments during the designated comment period.

units.obligation_text: During the comment period, the public will have access to the information upon which APHIS based its evaluation, as well as the evaluation itself.
units.actor: the public / APHIS (obligation to provide access)
units.action_summary: APHIS must provide public access to the evaluation and the information underlying it during the comment period.

units.obligation_text: Once APHIS has reviewed all comments received, it will make a final determination regarding the request and will publish that determination in the Federal Register.
units.action_summary: Requires APHIS to review comments, make a final determination, and publish that determination in the Federal Register.

units.obligation_text: If a region or compartment is granted animal health status under the provisions of this section, the representative of the national government(s) of any country or countries who has the authority to make a regionalization or compartmentalization request may be required to submit additional information pertaining to animal health status or allow APHIS to conduct additional information collection activities in order for that region or compartment to maintain its animal health status.
units.actor: the representative of the national government(s) (who made the request)
units.action_summary: Conditionally requires the requesting representative to submit additional information or permit APHIS information-collection to maintain granted animal health status.

units.obligation_text: If a region or a compartment recognized as free of a specified animal disease in this subchapter experiences an outbreak of that disease, APHIS will take immediate action to prohibit or restrict imports of animals and animal products from the entire region, a portion of that region, or the compartment.
units.action_summary: Requires APHIS to immediately prohibit or restrict imports from the affected region, portion, or compartment if an outbreak occurs.

units.obligation_text: prohibit or restrict imports of animals and animal products from the entire region
units.action_summary: Authorize prohibition or restriction of imports from the entire region.

units.obligation_text: prohibit or restrict imports of animals and animal products from a portion of that region
units.action_summary: Authorize prohibition or restriction of imports from a portion of the region.

units.obligation_text: prohibit or restrict imports of animals and animal products from the compartment
units.action_summary: Authorize prohibition or restriction of imports from the compartment.

units.obligation_text: APHIS will inform the public as soon as possible of the prohibitions and restrictions by means of a notice in the Federal Register.
units.action_summary: Requires APHIS to notify the public via Federal Register notice of any prohibitions or restrictions imposed.

units.obligation_text: Following removal of disease-free status from all or part of a region or a compartment, APHIS may reassess the disease situation in that region or compartment to determine whether it is necessary to continue the interim prohibitions or restrictions.
units.action_summary: Permits APHIS to reassess the disease situation after removal of disease-free status to decide if prohibitions/restrictions should continue.

units.obligation_text: In reassessing disease status, APHIS will take into consideration the standards of the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) for reinstatement of disease-free status, as well as all relevant information obtained through public comments or collected by or submitted to APHIS through other means.
units.action_summary: Requires APHIS to consider OIE standards and relevant information including public comments when reassessing disease status.

units.obligation_text: Prior to taking any action to relieve prohibitions or restrictions, APHIS will make information regarding its reassessment of the region’s or compartment’s disease status available to the public for comment.
units.action_summary: Requires APHIS to publish reassessment information for public comment before relieving prohibitions or restrictions.

units.obligation_text: APHIS will announce the availability of this information by means of a notice in the Federal Register.
units.action_summary: Requires APHIS to announce reassessment information availability via the Federal Register.

units.obligation_text: Based on the reassessment conducted in accordance with paragraph (b) of this section regarding the reassessment information, APHIS will take one of the following actions:
units.action_summary: Requires APHIS to take one of specified actions based on reassessment.

units.obligation_text: Publish a notice in the Federal Register of its decision to reinstate the disease-free status of the region, portion of the region, or compartment;
units.action_summary: APHIS must publish a Federal Register notice reinstating disease-free status if that is its decision.

units.obligation_text: Publish a notice in the Federal Register of its decision to continue the prohibitions or restrictions on the imports of animals and animal products from that region or compartment;
units.action_summary: APHIS must publish a Federal Register notice continuing prohibitions or restrictions if that is its decision.

units.obligation_text: Publish another document in the Federal Register for comment.
units.action_summary: APHIS may publish another Federal Register document to solicit further comment.

title: Domestic Quarantine Regulations: Pale Cyst Nematode

units.obligation_text: A field will be designated as an infested field for pale cyst nematode upon a determination that viable pale cyst nematode is present in the field.
units.action_summary: Designate a field as an infested field when viable pale cyst nematode is found there.

units.obligation_text: The determination will be made in accordance with the criteria established by the Administrator for the designation of infested fields.
units.action_summary: Make the determination using criteria established by the Administrator.

units.obligation_text: The criteria are presented in a protocol document that may be viewed at https://www.aphis.usda.gov/planthealth/pcn. The protocol may also be obtained by request from any local office of Plant Protection and Quarantine; local offices are listed in telephone directories.
units.action_summary: View the protocol at the specified website or obtain it by request from a local Plant Protection and Quarantine office.

units.obligation_text: Any substantive changes we propose to make to the protocol will be published for comment in the Federal Register.
units.action_summary: Publish any proposed substantive changes to the protocol in the Federal Register for public comment.

units.obligation_text: After we review the comments received, we will publish another notice in the Federal Register informing the public of any changes to the protocol.
units.action_summary: After reviewing comments, publish a notice in the Federal Register informing the public of any changes to the protocol.

units.obligation_text: An infested field will be removed from quarantine for pale cyst nematode upon a determination that no viable pale cyst nematode is detected in the field.
units.action_summary: Remove an infested field from quarantine when testing determines no viable pale cyst nematode is detected.

units.obligation_text: The determination will be made in accordance with criteria established by the Administrator and sufficient to support removal of infested fields from quarantine.
units.action_summary: Make the removal determination according to criteria established by the Administrator that are sufficient to support removal.

units.obligation_text: An associated field will be removed from quarantine for pale cyst nematode once surveys are completed and pale cyst nematode is not detected in the field.
units.action_summary: Remove an associated field from quarantine after surveys are completed and pale cyst nematode is not detected.

units.obligation_text: The determination will be made in accordance with criteria established by the Administrator and sufficient to support removal of associated fields from quarantine.
units.action_summary: Make the determination to remove an associated field based on criteria established by the Administrator.

units.obligation_text: If the Administrator has quarantined any area other than infested or associated fields because of its inseparability for quarantine enforcement purposes from infested or associated fields, as provided in paragraph (a) of this section, that area will be removed from quarantine when the relevant infested or associated fields are removed from quarantine.
units.action_summary: Remove other quarantined areas that were quarantined due to inseparability once the relevant infested or associated fields are removed from quarantine.

units.obligation_text: The Administrator will remove infested and associated fields, and other areas as provided in this section, from quarantine for pale cyst nematode in accordance with the protocols published on the Plant Protection and Quarantine website at https://www.aphis.usda.gov/planthealth/pcn.
units.action_summary: Remove infested, associated, and other specified areas from quarantine in accordance with the published protocols on the specified website.

units.obligation_text: The protocols may also be obtained by request from any local office of Plant Protection and Quarantine; local offices are listed in telephone directories.
units.action_summary: Obtain the protocols by request from any local Plant Protection and Quarantine office.

units.obligation_text: Any substantive changes we propose to make to the protocols will be published for comment in the Federal Register.
units.action_summary: Publish any proposed substantive changes to the protocols in the Federal Register for public comment.

units.obligation_text: After we review the comments received, we will publish another notice in the Federal Register informing the public of any changes to the protocols.
units.action_summary: After reviewing comments, publish a notice in the Federal Register informing the public of any changes to the protocols.
