units.obligation_text: Comply with this AD within the compliance times specified, unless already done.
units.action_summary: Must comply with the AD within the specified times unless already accomplished.

units.obligation_text: Replace the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling part number (P/N) N4211–375–M or P/N 5322C–375–Z ... with a new exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: Replace the specified old v-band coupling with a new v-band coupling.

units.obligation_text: When installing the new part, tighten the v-band coupling to 40 in-lbs., tap the periphery of the band to distribute tension, and torque again to 40 in-lbs.
units.action_summary: When installing the new coupling, torque to 40 in-lbs, tap to distribute tension, and re-torque to 40 in-lbs.

units.obligation_text: Do the replacement at the compliance times in paragraphs (g)(1) and (2) of this AD.
units.action_summary: Replacements must be done according to the timing rules in paragraphs (g)(1) and (g)(2).

units.obligation_text: We recommend after installation of the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling, you do an engine run and recheck the torque of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: Advisory: after installation, run the engine and recheck coupling torque.

units.obligation_text: If ... the hours time-in-service (TIS) for the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling is less than 500 hours TIS: Do the initial replacement within 500 hours TIS ... or within the next 50 hours TIS after the effective date of this AD, whichever occurs later, and replace repetitively thereafter at intervals not to exceed 500 hours TIS on the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If TIS <500, do initial replacement within specified time and then replace every 500 hours TIS or less.

units.obligation_text: If ... the hours TIS for the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling is 500 hours TIS or more or you cannot positively identify the hours TIS ...: Do the initial replacement within 50 hours TIS after the effective date of this AD and replace repetitively thereafter at intervals not to exceed 500 hours TIS on the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If TIS ≥500 or unknown, replace within 50 hours after the AD effective date, then every 500 hours TIS thereafter.

units.obligation_text: If the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling is removed for any reason before any replacement required by this AD, before reinstalling the same (existing) v-band coupling, you must do the inspection steps listed in paragraphs (h)(1)(i) through (vi) of this AD.
units.action_summary: If a coupling is removed prior to its life-limit replacement, you must perform the specified inspections before reinstalling that same coupling.

units.obligation_text: During the removal, inspection, and reinstallation do not open the coupling more than necessary because excessive flexing of the coupling can lead to damage.
units.action_summary: Do not open the coupling more than necessary while removing/inspecting/reinstalling to avoid damage.

units.obligation_text: Use crocus cloth and mineral spirits/Stoddard solvent, to clean the outer band of the v-band coupling. Pay particular attention to the spot weld areas on the coupling.
units.action_summary: Clean the outer band with crocus cloth and Stoddard solvent, focusing on spot weld areas.

units.obligation_text: Use a 10X magnifier to visually inspect the outer band for cracks, paying particular attention to the spot weld areas.
units.action_summary: Visually inspect the outer band for cracks with a 10X magnifier, focusing on spot welds.

units.obligation_text: If cracks are found during this inspection, do not re-install the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If cracks are found, you must not reinstall the coupling.

units.obligation_text: Before further flight, you must install a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If cracks are found, install a new coupling before further flight and restart the TIS counter for replacements.

units.obligation_text: Visually inspect the flatness of the outer band using a straight edge. Lay the straight edge across the width of the outer band. The gap must be less than 0.062 inches.
units.action_summary: Check flatness with a straight edge; the gap must be less than 0.062 inches.

units.obligation_text: If the gap exceeds 0.062 inches between the outer band and the straight edge, do not re-install the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If gap >0.062 inches, do not reinstall the coupling.

units.obligation_text: Before further flight, you must install a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If gap exceeds limit, install new coupling before flight and restart replacement TIS.

units.obligation_text: With the t-bolt in the 12 o’clock position, visually inspect the coupling for the attachment of the outer band to the v-retainer coupling segments by inspecting for gaps between the outer band and the v-retainer coupling segments between approximately the 1 o’clock through 11 o’clock position.
units.action_summary: Inspect attachment of outer band to v-retainer segments for gaps with t-bolt at 12 o'clock.

units.obligation_text: It is recommended to use backlighting to see gaps.
units.action_summary: Advisory: use backlighting to better see gaps during inspection.

units.obligation_text: If gaps between the outer band and the v-retainer coupling segments are found, do not re-install the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If gaps are found, do not reinstall the coupling.

units.obligation_text: Before further flight, you must install a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If gaps are found, install a new coupling before further flight and restart replacement hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: Visually inspect the bend radii of the coupling v-retainer coupling segments for cracks. Inspect the radii throughout the length of the segment.
units.action_summary: Inspect bend radii of v-retainer segments for cracks along their length.

units.obligation_text: If any cracks are found, do not re-install the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If cracks are found in bend radii, do not reinstall the coupling.

units.obligation_text: Before further flight, you must install a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If cracks in bend radii are found, install new coupling before flight and restart TIS.

units.obligation_text: Visually inspect the outer band opposite the t-bolt for damage (distortion, creases, bulging, or cracks) ...
units.action_summary: Inspect the outer band opposite the t-bolt for damage such as distortion, creases, bulging, or cracks.

units.obligation_text: If any damage is found, do not re-install the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If damage is found opposite the t-bolt, do not reinstall the coupling.

units.obligation_text: Before further flight, you must install a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If damage is found, install a new coupling before flight and restart the replacement hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: If the removed exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling passes all of the inspection steps listed in paragraphs (h)(1)(i) through (vi) of this AD, you may re-install the same v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If the removed coupling passes all inspections, you are permitted to reinstall the same coupling.

units.obligation_text: After the coupling is re-installed and torqued as specified in paragraph (g) of this AD, verify there is space between each v-retainer coupling segment below the t-bolt.
units.action_summary: After reinstalling and torquing, verify there is space between each v-retainer segment below the t-bolt.

units.obligation_text: If there is no space between each v-retainer coupling segment below the t-bolt, before further flight, you must install a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If no space exists between v-retainer segments after reinstallation, install a new coupling before flight and restart replacement TIS.

units.obligation_text: The inspections required in paragraphs (h)(1) and (2) of this AD only apply to re-installing the same exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling that was removed for any reason as specified in paragraph (h)(1) of this AD.
units.action_summary: The inspections in (h)(1) and (h)(2) apply only to reinstalling the same coupling removed per (h)(1).

units.obligation_text: It does not apply to installation of a new v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: The inspection steps do not apply to installation of a new coupling.

units.obligation_text: These inspections do not terminate the 500-hour TIS repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling and do not restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: These inspections neither end the 500-hour replacement requirement nor restart the replacement time-in-service counter.

units.obligation_text: After the effective date of this AD, do not install a used exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling on the airplane except for the reinstallation of the inspected exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling that was removed for any reason as specified in paragraph (h)(1) of this AD.
units.action_summary: Do not install used v-band couplings after the AD effective date, except you may reinstall a coupling that was removed and inspected per (h)(1).

units.obligation_text: Exception: reinstallation of the inspected exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling that was removed for any reason as specified in paragraph (h)(1) of this AD.
units.action_summary: Exception allows reinstalling a coupling that was removed and passed required inspections.

units.obligation_text: The Manager, Wichita Aircraft Certification Office (ACO), FAA, has the authority to approve AMOCs for this AD, if requested using the procedures found in 14 CFR 39.19.
units.action_summary: The Manager may approve alternative methods of compliance if requested per 14 CFR 39.19.

units.obligation_text: In accordance with 14 CFR 39.19, send your request to your principal inspector or local Flight Standards District Office, as appropriate.
units.action_summary: Requests for AMOCs must be sent to the principal inspector or local FSDO per 14 CFR 39.19.

units.obligation_text: If sending information directly to the manager of the ACO, send it to the attention of the person identified in paragraph (j) of this AD.
units.action_summary: If sending AMOC information directly to the manager, address it to the person identified in paragraph (j).

units.obligation_text: Before using any approved AMOC, notify your appropriate principal inspector, or lacking a principal inspector, the manager of the local flight standards district office/certificate holding district office.
units.actor: owners/operators / users of the approved AMOC
units.action_summary: Before using an approved AMOC, notify the appropriate principal inspector or local FSDO/CHDO manager.

title: Airworthiness Directives: Textron Aviation Inc. Airplanes

units.obligation_text: We must receive comments by December 26, 2017.
units.action_summary: Submit comments to the docket by December 26, 2017.

units.obligation_text: This AD applies to the following Textron Aviation Inc. airplanes; all serial numbers, that are certificated in any category: (i) Models A36TC and B36TC airplanes equipped with a turbocharged engine. (ii) Models S35, V35, V35A, and V35B airplanes equipped with the Continental TSIO–520–D engine with AiResearch turbocharger during manufacture; and (iii) Models S35, V35, V35A, and V35B airplanes equipped with StandardAero Supplemental Type Certificate (STC) SA1035WE.
units.actor: owners/operators of the specified Textron Aviation Inc. airplanes
units.action_summary: Specifies which Textron Aviation airplanes are subject to this AD.

units.obligation_text: If the one-piece v-band coupling (clamp), part number (P/N) NH1000897–40, is installed on Textron Aviation Inc. Models S35, V35, V35A, and V35B airplanes equipped with the Continental TSIO–520–D engine with AiResearch turbocharger during manufacture, this AD does not apply to those airplanes.
units.actor: owners/operators of Models S35, V35, V35A, and V35B with P/N NH1000897–40 installed
units.action_summary: Airplanes with the one-piece v-band coupling P/N NH1000897–40 installed are exempt from this AD.

units.obligation_text: Comply with this AD within the compliance times specified, unless already done.
units.action_summary: Follow all AD requirements within the specified compliance times unless already completed.

units.obligation_text: Within 50 hours time-in-service (TIS) after the effective date of this AD, do a maintenance records review to determine the hours TIS of the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: Within 50 hours TIS, review maintenance records to determine hours TIS on the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling.

units.obligation_text: If unable to determine the hours TIS of the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling, use the compliance time specified in paragraph (h)(2) of this AD.
units.action_summary: If hours TIS cannot be determined from records, follow the compliance schedule in paragraph (h)(2).

units.obligation_text: Use the following compliance times in paragraph (h)(1) or (2) for the repetitive replacement of the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling as specified in paragraph (i) of this AD.
units.action_summary: Follow the compliance time rules in (h)(1) or (h)(2) to perform repetitive replacements per paragraph (i).

units.obligation_text: If from a review of the maintenance records you can positively identify that the hours TIS for the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling is less than 500 hours TIS: Do the initial replacement within 500 hours TIS on the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling or within the next 50 hours TIS after the effective date of this AD, whichever occurs later, and replace repetitively thereafter at intervals not to exceed 500 hours TIS on the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If records show coupling has <500 hours TIS, do initial replacement within specified time (500 hours or within next 50 hours whichever later) and then replace every 500 hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: Do the initial replacement within 500 hours TIS on the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling or within the next 50 hours TIS after the effective date of this AD, whichever occurs later.
units.action_summary: Initial replacement timing requirement when hours TIS are known and <500.

units.obligation_text: Replace repetitively thereafter at intervals not to exceed 500 hours TIS on the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: Repetitively replace the v-band coupling at intervals no greater than 500 hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: If from a review of the maintenance records you can positively identify that the hours TIS for the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling is 500 hours TIS or more or you cannot positively identify the hours TIS for the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling: Do the initial replacement within 50 hours TIS after the effective date of this AD and replace repetitively thereafter at intervals not to exceed 500 hours TIS on the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If coupling has ≥500 hours or hours unknown, do initial replacement within 50 hours after the AD effective date and then replace every 500 hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: Do the initial replacement within 50 hours TIS after the effective date of this AD.
units.action_summary: Initial replacement must be done within 50 hours TIS if hours are ≥500 or unknown.

units.obligation_text: Replace repetitively thereafter at intervals not to exceed 500 hours TIS on the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: Repetitively replace the v-band coupling at intervals no greater than 500 hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: Replace the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling for the airplanes in paragraphs (i)(1) through (3) at the applicable compliance time as specified in paragraph (h).
units.action_summary: Replace the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling on listed airplanes at the compliance times specified in (h).

units.obligation_text: We recommend after installation of the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling, you do an engine run and recheck the torque of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: Recommended (non-mandatory): run the engine and recheck v-band coupling torque after installation.

units.obligation_text: Models A36TC and B36TC airplanes: Replace the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling part number (P/N) N4211–375–M or P/N 5322C–375–Z with a new exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling.
units.actor: owners/operators/maintenance personnel of Models A36TC and B36TC
units.action_summary: Replace the specified P/N v-band couplings with new v-band couplings on A36TC and B36TC airplanes.

units.obligation_text: When installing the new part, tighten the v-band coupling to 40 in-lbs., tap the periphery of the band to distribute tension, and torque again to 40 in-lbs.
units.actor: owners/operators/maintenance personnel installing the v-band coupling
units.action_summary: When installing the new v-band coupling, torque to 40 in-lbs, tap to distribute tension, then torque to 40 in-lbs again.

units.obligation_text: Models S35, V35, V35A, and V35B airplanes: (i) For airplanes equipped with the Continental TSIO–520–D engine with AiResearch turbocharger during manufacture: Replace the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling P/N U4211–375–M or P/N 4404C375–M with a new exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling. (ii) For airplanes equipped with STC SA1035WE: Replace the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling P/N U4211–375–M with a new exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling.
units.actor: owners/operators/maintenance personnel of Models S35, V35, V35A, and V35B
units.action_summary: Replace specified P/N v-band couplings with new ones on listed models, per the subparagraphs for engine/STC configurations.

units.obligation_text: For airplanes equipped with the Continental TSIO–520–D engine with AiResearch turbocharger during manufacture: Replace the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling P/N U4211–375–M or P/N 4404C375–M with a new exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling.
units.actor: owners/operators/maintenance personnel of applicable S35/V35 models with Continental TSIO–520–D with AiResearch turbocharger
units.action_summary: Replace P/N U4211–375–M or P/N 4404C375–M with a new v-band coupling on these airplanes.

units.obligation_text: When installing a new P/N U4211–375–M, tighten the v-band coupling to 60 in-lbs., tap the periphery of the band to distribute tension, and torque again to 60 in-lbs.
units.action_summary: Installation procedure for P/N U4211–375–M: torque to 60 in-lbs, tap, then torque to 60 in-lbs again.

units.obligation_text: When installing a new P/N 4404C375–M, add 20 in-lbs after the running torque is overcome.
units.action_summary: When installing P/N 4404C375–M, after overcoming running torque, add 20 in-lbs.

units.obligation_text: Replacement of exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling P/N U4211–375–M or P/N 4404C375–M with the one-piece v-band coupling, P/N NH1000897–40, terminates the requirements of this AD.
units.action_summary: Installing the one-piece coupling P/N NH1000897–40 ends the AD's requirements for that airplane.

units.obligation_text: For airplanes equipped with STC SA1035WE: Replace the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling P/N U4211–375–M with a new exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling. When installing the new part, tighten the v-band coupling to 60 in-lbs., tap the periphery of the band to distribute tension, and torque again to 60 in-lbs.
units.actor: owners/operators/maintenance personnel of airplanes equipped with STC SA1035WE
units.action_summary: Replace P/N U4211–375–M with a new v-band coupling and torque to 60 in-lbs, tap, torque to 60 in-lbs.

units.obligation_text: Repetitively do a visual inspection of the installed exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling at the next annual inspection after the effective date of this AD or within the next 12 months after the effective date of this AD, whichever occurs later, and repetitively thereafter at intervals not to exceed 12 months; use the inspection steps listed in paragraphs (j)(2)(i) through (vii).
units.action_summary: Perform visual inspections of the installed v-band coupling at the next annual or within 12 months and then every 12 months, following specified steps.

units.obligation_text: If you remove the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling during your annual inspection or within the compliance time specified in paragraph (j)(2) of this AD, you may do the inspection specified in paragraph (k) of this AD in lieu of the inspection required in paragraph (j) of this AD.
units.action_summary: If the coupling is removed during annual or within j(2) compliance time, you may perform the removed-coupling inspection of paragraph (k) instead of the installed inspection in (j).

units.obligation_text: At the next annual inspection after the effective date of this AD or within the next 12 months after the effective date of this AD, whichever occurs later, and repetitively thereafter at intervals not to exceed 12 months, do a visual inspection of the installed exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling. Use the inspection steps listed in paragraphs (j)(2)(i) through (vii) of this AD.
units.action_summary: Mandates timing and repetition intervals for the visual inspection and directs use of the listed inspection steps.

units.obligation_text: Inspect the coupling and area around the coupling for signs of exhaust stains, sooting, or other evidence of exhaust leakage. If any of those conditions are found, remove the coupling and go to the inspection steps in paragraph (k) of this AD for inspection of a v-band coupling that has been removed.
units.action_summary: Inspect for evidence of leakage; if found, remove the coupling and perform the removed-coupling inspection in paragraph (k).

units.obligation_text: Inspect the coupling outer band for cracks, paying particular attention to the spot weld areas. If cracks are found, before further flight, you must replace the v-band coupling with a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If cracks are found in the outer band, replace the v-band coupling before further flight and reset the replacement interval hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: Inspect the coupling for looseness or separation of the outer band to the v-retainer segments(s) at all spot welds. If looseness or separation of the outer band to any or multiple retainer segments(s) is found, before further flight, you must replace the v-band coupling with a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If looseness or separation is found, replace the v-band coupling before further flight and reset the replacement interval hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: Inspect the coupling outer band for cupping, bowing, or crowning. If any of these conditions are found, before further flight, remove the coupling and go to the inspection steps in paragraph (k) of this AD for inspection of a v-band coupling that has been removed.
units.action_summary: If cupping, bowing, or crowning is found, remove the coupling and perform the removed-coupling inspection in paragraph (k) before further flight.

units.obligation_text: Inspect the area of the coupling, including the outer band, opposite the t-bolt for damage or distortion. If any damage or distortion is found, before further flight, you must replace the v-band coupling with a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If damage or distortion is found opposite the t-bolt, replace the v-band coupling before further flight and reset the replacement interval hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: Using a mirror, verify there is a space between each v-retainer coupling segment below the t-bolt. If there is no space between each v-retainer coupling segment below the t-bolt, before further flight, you must replace the v-band coupling with a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: Verify spacing between v-retainer segments; if no space, replace the v-band coupling before further flight and reset hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: For P/N N4211–375–M or P/N 5322C–375–Z exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling, torque to 40 in-lbs.
units.action_summary: Torque the nut for specified P/Ns to 40 in-lbs.

units.obligation_text: For P/N U4211–375–M exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling, torque to 60 in-lbs.
units.action_summary: Torque the nut for P/N U4211–375–M to 60 in-lbs.

units.obligation_text: For 4404C375–M exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling, verify the nut is secure. If not secure, before further flight, loosen and verify running torque and add 20 in-lbs to the running torque when tightened.
units.action_summary: Verify nut security for P/N 4404C375–M; if not secure, loosen, verify running torque, and add 20 in-lbs when tightening before further flight.

units.obligation_text: These inspections do not terminate the 500-hour TIS repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling and do not restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: The visual inspections required in (j) do not replace the 500-hour replacement requirement and do not reset its clock.

units.obligation_text: If during the visual inspection required in paragraph (j) of this AD you are required to remove the exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling to do a more detailed inspection, you must do the inspection steps listed in paragraphs (k)(1) and (2) of this AD.
units.action_summary: If the coupling is removed for detailed inspection, perform the specified removed-coupling inspection steps in (k)(1) and (k)(2).

units.obligation_text: Use crocus cloth and mineral spirits/Stoddard solvent, to clean the outer band of the v-band coupling. Pay particular attention to the spot weld areas on the coupling. If during cleaning corrosion cannot be removed or pitting of the v-band coupling is found, do not re-install the v-band coupling. Before further flight, you must install a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: Clean the outer band with specified materials; if corrosion/pitting cannot be removed, do not reinstall and install a new v-band coupling before further flight and reset hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: Use a 10X magnifier to visually inspect the outer band for cracks, paying particular attention to the spot weld areas. If cracks are found during this inspection, do not re-install the v-band coupling. Before further flight, you must install a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: Inspect outer band with 10X magnifier for cracks; if cracks are found, do not reinstall and install a new coupling before further flight and reset hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: Visually inspect the flatness of the outer band using a straight edge. Lay the straight edge across the width of the outer band. The gap must be less than 0.062 inches. If the gap exceeds 0.062 inches between the outer band and the straight edge, do not re-install the v-band coupling. Before further flight, you must install a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: Check flatness with straight edge; gap must be <0.062 inches. If larger, do not reinstall and fit a new coupling before further flight and reset hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: With the t-bolt in the 12 o’clock position, visually inspect the coupling for the attachment of the outer band to the v-retainer coupling segments by inspecting for gaps between the outer band and the v-retainer coupling segments between approximately the 1 o’clock through 11 o’clock position. If gaps between the outer band and the v-retainer coupling segments are found, do not re-install the v-band coupling. Before further flight, you must install a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: Inspect attachment between outer band and retainer segments for gaps with t-bolt at 12 o'clock; if gaps found, do not reinstall and install a new coupling before further flight and reset hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: Visually inspect the bend radii of the coupling v-retainer coupling segments for cracks. Inspect the radii throughout the length of the segment. If any cracks are found, do not re-install the v-band coupling. Before further flight, you must install a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: Inspect bend radii of retainer segments for cracks; if any cracks found, do not reinstall and install a new coupling before further flight and reset hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: Visually inspect the outer band opposite the t-bolt for damage (distortion, creases, bulging, or cracks). If any damage is found, do not re-install the v-band coupling. Before further flight, you must install a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: Inspect outer band opposite t-bolt for damage; if damage found, do not reinstall and install a new coupling before further flight and reset hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: If the removed exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling passes all of the inspection steps listed in paragraphs (k)(1)(i) through (vi) of this AD, you may re-install the same v-band coupling. After the coupling is re-installed and torqued as specified in Replacement of the V-Band Coupling, paragraph (i) of this AD, verify there is space between each v-retainer coupling segment below the t-bolt. If there is no space between each v-retainer coupling segment below the t-bolt, before further flight, you must install a new v-band coupling and restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: If the removed coupling passes all checks, you may reinstall it; after reinstalling and torquing, verify spacing; if no spacing, install a new coupling before further flight and reset hours TIS.

units.obligation_text: The inspections required in paragraphs (k)(1) and (2) of this AD only apply to re-installing the same exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling that was removed as specified in paragraph (j) of this AD. It does not apply to installation of a new v-band coupling. These inspections do not terminate the 500-hour TIS repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling and do not restart the hours TIS for the repetitive replacement of the v-band coupling.
units.action_summary: Clarifies that the removed-coupling inspections apply only to reinstallation of the same coupling and do not replace or reset the 500-hour replacement requirement.

units.obligation_text: As of the effective date of this AD, do not install a used exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling on the airplane except for the reinstallation of the inspected exhaust tailpipe v-band coupling that was removed as specified in paragraphs (j) and (k) of this AD.
units.action_summary: Prohibits installing used v-band couplings except for reinstalling an inspected coupling removed under paragraphs (j) and (k).

title: Airworthiness Directives: The Boeing Company Airplanes

units.obligation_text: We must receive comments by June 16, 2017.
units.action_summary: Submit comments by June 16, 2017.

units.obligation_text: Comply with this AD within the compliance times specified, unless already done.
units.action_summary: Comply with this AD within the specified compliance times unless already accomplished.

units.obligation_text: Except as required by paragraph (h) of this AD: Do all applicable actions identified as required for compliance ("RC") in, and in accordance with, the Accomplishment Instructions of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 737–53A1349, dated August 23, 2016. Do the actions at the applicable times specified in paragraph 1.E., "Compliance," of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 737–53A1349, dated August 23, 2016.
units.actor: owners/operators of affected airplanes / maintenance personnel
units.action_summary: Perform all RC actions in the Boeing Alert Service Bulletin as instructed and at the specified times, except as provided in paragraph (h).

units.obligation_text: Where Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 737–53A1349, dated August 23, 2016, uses the phrase "after the original issue of this service bulletin," for purposes of determining compliance with the requirements of this AD, the phrase "after the effective date of this AD" must be used.
units.actor: persons determining compliance / operators / maintenance personnel
units.action_summary: Interpret the service bulletin phrase 'after the original issue of this service bulletin' as 'after the effective date of this AD' for compliance purposes.

units.obligation_text: Where Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 737–53A1349, dated August 23, 2016, specifies contacting Boeing for instructions, and specifies that action as "RC" (Required for Compliance): This AD requires using a method approved in accordance with the procedures specified in paragraph (k) of this AD.
units.action_summary: If the bulletin directs to contact Boeing for an RC action, you must instead use a method approved per paragraph (k).

units.obligation_text: For replaced skin panels identified in table 9 of paragraph 1.E., "Compliance," of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 737–53A1349, dated August 23, 2016, on which the one-time internal inspection specified in Service Bulletin 737–53–1179, Revision 2, dated October 25, 2001, has not been done: The compliance time for accomplishment of the actions specified in Part 8 of the Accomplishment Instructions of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 737–53A1349, dated August 23, 2016, is at the latest of the times specified in paragraphs (h)(3)(i), (h)(3)(ii), and (h)(3)(iii) of this AD.
units.action_summary: For certain replaced skin panels lacking the one-time internal inspection, the compliance time for Part 8 actions is the latest of three specified flight-cycle thresholds.

units.obligation_text: Within 50,000 flight cycles after the skin panel replacement.
units.action_summary: Perform the required Part 8 actions within 50,000 flight cycles after the skin panel replacement (if that threshold is the latest).

units.obligation_text: Within 20,000 flight cycles after July 14, 2003 (the effective date of AD 2003–14–16).
units.action_summary: Perform the required Part 8 actions within 20,000 flight cycles after July 14, 2003 (if that threshold is the latest).

units.obligation_text: Within 4,500 flight cycles after the effective date of this AD.
units.action_summary: Perform the required Part 8 actions within 4,500 flight cycles after this AD's effective date (if that threshold is the latest).

units.obligation_text: Accomplishment of any skin panel replacement, as specified in the Accomplishment Instructions of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 737–53A1349, dated August 23, 2016, except as required by paragraph (h)(2) of this AD, terminates the repetitive inspections required by paragraph (g) of this AD at the replaced skin panel only.
units.action_summary: Replacing a skin panel per the service bulletin (except as H(2) requires) ends the repetitive inspections at that replaced panel.

units.obligation_text: Accomplishment of the initial inspections required by paragraph (g) of this AD terminates all requirements of AD 2003–14–06.
units.action_summary: Completing the initial inspections required by this AD ends all requirements of AD 2003–14–06.

units.obligation_text: The Manager, Los Angeles Aircraft Certification Office, FAA, has the authority to approve AMOCs for this AD, if requested using the procedures found in 14 CFR 39.19.
units.actor: Manager, Los Angeles Aircraft Certification Office (FAA)
units.action_summary: The Manager, LA ACO may approve AMOCs for this AD when requested per 14 CFR 39.19.

units.obligation_text: In accordance with 14 CFR 39.19, send your request to your principal inspector or local Flight Standards District Office, as appropriate.
units.action_summary: Send AMOC requests to your principal inspector or local FSDO in accordance with 14 CFR 39.19.

units.obligation_text: If sending information directly to the manager of the ACO, send it to the attention of the person identified in paragraph (l)(1) of this AD.
units.action_summary: If sending information directly to the ACO manager, address it to the person identified in paragraph (l)(1).

units.obligation_text: Information may be emailed to: 9-ANM-LAACO-AMOC-Requests@faa.gov.
units.action_summary: AMOC requests may be emailed to the specified email address.

units.obligation_text: Before using any approved AMOC, notify your appropriate principal inspector, or lacking a principal inspector, the manager of the local flight standards district office/certificate holding district office.
units.action_summary: Notify your principal inspector (or local manager) before using any approved AMOC.

units.obligation_text: An AMOC that provides an acceptable level of safety may be used for any repair, modification, or alteration required by this AD if it is approved by the Boeing Commercial Airplanes Organization Designation Authorization (ODA) that has been authorized by the Manager, Seattle ACO, to make those findings.
units.action_summary: You may use an AMOC approved by the authorized Boeing ODA for repairs, modifications, or alterations required by this AD.

units.obligation_text: To be approved, the repair method, modification deviation, or alteration deviation must meet the certification basis of the airplane, and the approval must specifically refer to this AD.
units.action_summary: Approval of a repair/modification/alteration requires meeting the airplane's certification basis and must explicitly reference this AD.

units.obligation_text: The steps labeled as RC, including substeps under an RC step and any figures identified in an RC step, must be done to comply with the AD.
units.action_summary: Any steps labeled RC in the service information (including substeps and figures) must be performed to comply with the AD.

units.obligation_text: If a step or substep is labeled "RC Exempt," then the RC requirement is removed from that step or substep.
units.action_summary: A label of 'RC Exempt' removes the RC requirement for that step or substep.

units.obligation_text: An AMOC is required for any deviations to RC steps, including substeps and identified figures.
units.action_summary: You must obtain an AMOC to deviate from any RC steps, substeps, or figures.

units.obligation_text: Steps not labeled as RC may be deviated from using accepted methods in accordance with the operator’s maintenance or inspection program without obtaining approval of an AMOC, provided the RC steps, including substeps and identified figures, can still be done as specified, and the airplane can be put back in an airworthy condition.
units.action_summary: You may deviate from non-RC steps under your maintenance/inspection program without AMOC approval if RC steps remain achievable and the airplane can be returned to an airworthy condition.

units.obligation_text: For Group 1 airplanes as identified in Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 757–53A0101, dated November 8, 2016: At the applicable time specified in paragraph 1.E., "Compliance," of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 757–53A0101, dated November 8, 2016; except as specified in paragraph (i)(1) of this AD, do a surface high frequency eddy current (HFEC) inspection for any cracking of the fuselage STA 1380 frame inner chord, and do all applicable corrective actions, in accordance with the Accomplishment Instructions of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 757–53A0101, dated November 8, 2016; except as specified in paragraph (i)(2) of this AD.
units.action_summary: At the specified times, perform HFEC inspection for cracking of the STA 1380 frame inner chord and perform all applicable corrective actions per the Boeing Alert Service Bulletin, subject to exceptions in paragraph (i).

units.section: § 39.13 The Boeing Company AD (g) - corrective action timing
units.obligation_text: Do all applicable corrective actions before further flight.
units.action_summary: Any corrective actions found must be completed before the airplane may next fly.

units.section: § 39.13 The Boeing Company AD (g) - repeat inspections
units.obligation_text: Repeat the surface HFEC inspection, thereafter, at the times specified in paragraph 1.E., "Compliance," of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 757–53A0101, dated November 8, 2016.
units.action_summary: After the initial inspection, repeat HFEC inspections at the intervals specified in the service bulletin.

units.obligation_text: For Group 2 airplanes as identified in Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 757–53A0101, dated November 8, 2016: At the applicable time specified in paragraph 1.E., "Compliance," of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 757–53A0101, dated November 8, 2016; except as specified in paragraph (i)(1) of this AD, identify the material of the fuselage STA 1380 frame inner chord, in accordance with the Accomplishment Instructions of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 757–53A0101, dated November 8, 2016.
units.action_summary: At the specified time, identify the material of the fuselage STA 1380 frame inner chord per the service bulletin instructions.

units.obligation_text: If the fuselage STA 1380 frame inner chord material 2024–T42 aluminum alloy is found during any identification required by paragraph (h) of this AD: No further action is required by this AD for that airplane.
units.action_summary: If material is 2024–T42, the AD imposes no further actions for that airplane.

units.obligation_text: If the fuselage STA 1380 frame inner chord material 7075–T73 aluminum alloy is found during any identification required by paragraph (h) of this AD: Before further flight, do a surface HFEC inspection for any cracking of the fuselage STA 1380 frame inner chord, and do all applicable corrective actions, in accordance with the Accomplishment Instructions of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 757–53A0101, dated November 8, 2016; except as specified in paragraph (i)(2) of this AD.
units.action_summary: If material is 7075–T73, before further flight perform HFEC inspection for cracking and do all applicable corrective actions per the service bulletin (subject to paragraph (i)(2)).

units.section: § 39.13 The Boeing Company AD (h)(2) - corrective action timing
units.obligation_text: Do all applicable corrective actions before further flight.
units.action_summary: Any corrective actions identified must be completed before the airplane may next fly.

units.section: § 39.13 The Boeing Company AD (h)(2) - repeat inspections
units.obligation_text: Repeat the surface HFEC inspection, thereafter, at the times specified in paragraph 1.E., "Compliance," of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 757–53A0101, dated November 8, 2016.
units.action_summary: After the initial inspection, repeat HFEC inspections at the intervals specified in the service bulletin.

units.obligation_text: Where Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 757–53A0101, dated November 8, 2016, specifies a compliance time "after the original issue date of this service bulletin," this AD requires compliance within the specified compliance time after the effective date of this AD.
units.action_summary: When the service bulletin measures compliance time from its original issue date, this AD instead requires compliance within that time measured from the AD's effective date.

units.obligation_text: Where Boeing Alert Service Bulletin 757–53A0101, dated November 8, 2016, specifies to contact Boeing for appropriate action and identifies that action as "RC" (Required for Compliance): Before further flight, repair the crack using a method approved in accordance with the procedures specified in paragraph (j) of this AD.
units.action_summary: If the service bulletin directs to contact Boeing for an RC action, repair the crack before further flight using a method approved per paragraph (j).

units.obligation_text: The steps labeled as RC, including substeps under an RC step and any figures identified in an RC step, must be done to comply with the AD. units.section: (g) Retained Repetitive Inspections With Added Reference to Terminating Action
units.obligation_text: At the applicable time specified in paragraph (g)(1) or (g)(2) of this AD, do a general visual inspection of the bilge barriers located in the forward and aft cargo compartments for disengaged decompression panels, in accordance with the Accomplishment Instructions of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin B787–81205–SB500009–00, Issue 001, dated November 16, 2015. Repeat the inspection thereafter at the applicable times specified in paragraph 5. "Compliance," of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin B787–81205–SB500009–00, Issue 001, dated November 16, 2015; until the terminating modification required by paragraph (i) of this AD is done.
units.action_summary: Perform initial and repetitive general visual inspections of bilge barriers for disengaged decompression panels per the specified Boeing Alert Service Bulletin, and repeat at the specified intervals until the terminating modification is done.

units.obligation_text: For Group 1 airplanes identified in Boeing Alert Service Bulletin B787–81205–SB500009–00, Issue 001, dated November 16, 2015: Inspect within 30 days after May 23, 2016 (the effective date of AD 2016–09–12).
units.action_summary: Inspect within 30 days after May 23, 2016.

units.obligation_text: For Group 2 airplanes identified in Boeing Alert Service Bulletin B787–81205–SB500009–00, Issue 001, dated November 16, 2015: Inspect within 180 flight cycles or within 90 days after May 23, 2016 (the effective date of AD 2016–09–12), whichever occurs later.
units.action_summary: Inspect within 180 flight cycles or within 90 days after May 23, 2016, whichever occurs later.

units.obligation_text: Do the inspection in accordance with the Accomplishment Instructions of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin B787–81205–SB500009–00, Issue 001, dated November 16, 2015.
units.action_summary: Perform the inspections following the specified Accomplishment Instructions of the Boeing Alert Service Bulletin.

units.obligation_text: Repeat the inspection thereafter at the applicable times specified in paragraph 5. "Compliance," of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin B787–81205–SB500009–00, Issue 001, dated November 16, 2015; until the terminating modification required by paragraph (i) of this AD is done.
units.action_summary: Repeat inspections at the intervals specified in the service bulletin until the terminating modification is accomplished.

units.section: (h) Retained Reinstallation of Decompression Panels With No Changes
units.obligation_text: If any disengaged decompression panel is found during any inspection required by paragraph (g) of this AD; before further flight, reinstall the panel, in accordance with the Accomplishment Instructions of Boeing Alert Service Bulletin B787–81205–SB500009–00, Issue 001, dated November 16, 2015.
