title:
Radiological Health Regulations; Amendments to Records and Reports
for Radiation Emitting Electronic Products; Amendments to Performance Standards for Diagnostic X-Ray, Laser and Ultrasonic Products

units.obligation_text: Manufacturers of electronic products shall, where reasonable grounds for suspecting that such an incident has occurred, report to the Director, Center for Devices and Radiological Health, all accidental radiation occurrences reported to or otherwise known to the manufacturer and arising from the manufacturing, testing, or use of any product introduced or intended to be introduced into commerce by such manufacturer.
units.action_summary: Report to the Director all accidental radiation occurrences known or reported that arise from manufacturing, testing, or use of products introduced or intended for commerce when there are reasonable grounds to suspect such an incident.

units.obligation_text: Such reports shall be submitted electronically through Center for Devices and Radiological Health eSubmitter or addressed to Food and Drug Administration, Center for Devices and Radiological Health, ATTN: Accidental Radiation Occurrence Reports, Document Mail Center, 10903 New Hampshire Ave., Bldg. 66, Rm. G609, Silver Spring, MD 20993–0002, and the reports and their envelopes shall be distinctly marked "Report on 1002.20" and shall contain all of the following information where known to the manufacturer:
units.action_summary: Submit reports electronically via CDRH eSubmitter or by mail to the specified address, mark them "Report on 1002.20", and include the required information.

units.obligation_text: (1) The nature of the accidental radiation occurrence;
units.action_summary: Include the nature of the accidental radiation occurrence in the report, where known.

units.obligation_text: (2) The location at which the accidental radiation occurrence occurred;
units.action_summary: Include the location where the occurrence happened, where known.

units.obligation_text: (3) The manufacturer, type, and model number of the electronic product or products involved;
units.action_summary: Provide the manufacturer, type, and model number of the products involved, where known.

units.obligation_text: (4) The circumstances surrounding the accidental radiation occurrence, including causes;
units.action_summary: Describe the circumstances and causes surrounding the occurrence, where known.

units.obligation_text: (5) The number of persons involved, adversely affected, or exposed during the accidental radiation occurrence, the nature and magnitude of their exposure and/or injuries and, if requested by the Director, Center for Devices and Radiological Health, the names of the persons involved;
units.action_summary: Report number of persons involved or exposed, nature/magnitude of exposures/injuries, and provide names if requested by the Director.

units.obligation_text: (6) The actions, if any, which may have been taken by the manufacturer, to control, correct, or eliminate the causes and to prevent reoccurrence; and
units.action_summary: Describe any actions taken by the manufacturer to control, correct, or eliminate causes and prevent recurrence.

units.obligation_text: (7) Any other pertinent information with respect to the accidental radiation occurrence.
units.action_summary: Include any other pertinent information about the accidental radiation occurrence.

units.obligation_text: (1) Is required to report to the Director under paragraph (a) of this section and also is required to report under part 803 of this chapter, the manufacturer shall report in accordance with part 803;
units.action_summary: If required to report under §1002.20(a) and part 803, the manufacturer must report in accordance with part 803.

units.obligation_text: (2) Is required to report to the Director under paragraph (a) of this section and is not required to report under part 803 of this chapter, the manufacturer shall:
units.action_summary: If required to report under paragraph (a) but not subject to part 803, the manufacturer must follow the specified reporting options below.

units.obligation_text: (i) Immediately report incidents associated with a death or serious injury in accordance with paragraphs (a) and (b) of this section; and
units.action_summary: Immediately report incidents associated with death or serious injury per paragraphs (a) and (b).

units.obligation_text: (ii) Either immediately report incidents not associated with a death or serious injury individually or compile such incidents for submission in a quarterly summary report with tracking and trending analysis of that data in accordance with paragraphs (a) and (b) of this section.
units.action_summary: For incidents not involving death/serious injury, either immediately report each incident or compile them into a quarterly summary report with tracking and trending analysis as specified.

units.obligation_text: A manufacturer need not file a separate report under this section if an incident involving an accidental radiation occurrence is associated with a defect or noncompliance and is reported pursuant to § 1003.10 of this chapter.
units.action_summary: Manufacturers are not required to file a separate report under this section for incidents associated with a defect or noncompliance if reported under §1003.10.

units.obligation_text: If you are submitting an application for variances or for amendments or extensions thereof, you must submit an original copy by mail to the Dockets Management Staff (HFA–305), Food and Drug Administration, 5630 Fishers Lane, Rm. 1061, Rockville, MD 20852.
units.actor: Person submitting an application for variances (applicant)
units.action_summary: Applicants for variances must submit an original copy by mail to the specified Dockets Management Staff address.

units.obligation_text: Applications for variance can also be submitted electronically through the Regulations.gov website under Docket Number FDA–2013–S–0610 as a new comment with an upload of the variance application materials.
units.actor: Person submitting an application for variances (applicant)
units.action_summary: Applicants may alternatively submit variance applications electronically via Regulations.gov under the specified docket number.

units.obligation_text: All assemblers who install certified components shall file a report of assembly, except as specified in paragraph (d)(2) of this section. The report will be construed as the assembler’s certification and identification under §§ 1010.2 and 1010.3 of this chapter.
units.actor: All assemblers who install certified components
units.action_summary: Assemblers who install certified components must file a report of assembly (subject to exceptions) which serves as their certification and identification under §§1010.2 and 1010.3.

units.obligation_text: The assembler shall affirm in the report that the manufacturer's instructions were followed in the assembly or that the certified components as assembled into the system meet all applicable requirements of §§ 1020.30 through 1020.33.
units.action_summary: The assembler must affirm in the report either that the manufacturer's instructions were followed or that the assembled certified components meet all applicable requirements of §§1020.30–1020.33.

units.obligation_text: All assembler reports must be on a form prescribed by the Director, Center for Devices and Radiological Health.
units.action_summary: Assembler reports are required to use the form prescribed by the Director, CDRH.

units.obligation_text: Completed reports must be submitted to the purchaser and, where applicable, to the State agency responsible for radiation protection within 15 days following completion of the assembly.
units.action_summary: Submit completed assembler reports to the purchaser and, if applicable, the State radiation protection agency within 15 days of completing assembly.

units.obligation_text: The provisions of this section and § 1040.11, are not applicable to an uncertified laser product that is incorporated into an electronic product that is then certified by the manufacturer of such finished electronic product in accordance with § 1010.2 of this chapter, when: (i) ... (ii) ... (iii) ...
units.actor: Manufacturer of an uncertified laser product / manufacturer of finished electronic product
units.action_summary: Provides an exception: the section's provisions do not apply to an uncertified laser product incorporated into a certified electronic product if specified conditions are met.

units.obligation_text: (i) Such a laser product is either sold to a manufacturer of an electronic product for use as a component (or replacement) in such electronic product, or
units.action_summary: Condition for exception: the uncertified laser product is sold to an electronic product manufacturer for use as a component or replacement.

units.obligation_text: (A) Is accompanied by a general warning notice that adequate instructions for the safe installation of the laser product are provided in servicing information available from the complete laser product manufacturer under paragraph (h)(2)(ii) of this section, and should be followed,
units.action_summary: The laser product must be accompanied by a general warning that servicing information with adequate installation instructions is available and those instructions should be followed.

units.obligation_text: (B) Is labeled with a statement that it is designated for use solely as a component of such electronic product and therefore does not comply with the appropriate requirements of this section and § 1040.11 for complete laser products, and
units.action_summary: The laser product must be labeled stating it is for use solely as a component and does not comply with full product requirements.

units.obligation_text: (C) Is not a removable laser system as described in paragraph (c)(2) of this section;
units.action_summary: The laser product must not be a removable laser system as defined in paragraph (c)(2).

units.obligation_text: (iii) The manufacturer of such a laser product, if manufactured after August 20, 1986: (A) Registers, and provides a listing by type of such laser products manufactured that includes the product name, model number and laser medium or emitted wavelength(s), and the name and address of the manufacturer. The manufacturer must submit the registration and listing to the Director, Center for Devices and Radiological Health, Food and Drug Administration, 10903 New Hampshire Ave., Bldg. 66, Rm. G609, Silver Spring, MD 20993–0002.
units.actor: Manufacturer of the laser product (if manufactured after Aug 20, 1986)
units.action_summary: Manufacturers must register and provide a listing by type (including product name, model, laser medium/wavelength, and manufacturer name/address) and submit the registration/listing to the Director, CDRH.

units.obligation_text: Alternatively, reports may be submitted electronically through Center for Devices and Radiological Health eSubmitter.
units.action_summary: Manufacturers may submit registration/listing reports electronically via CDRH eSubmitter as an alternative to mailing.

units.obligation_text: (B) Maintains and allows access to any sales, shipping, or distribution records that identify the purchaser of such a laser product by name and address, the product by type, the number of units sold, and the date of sale (shipment). These records shall be maintained and made available as specified in § 1002.31 of this chapter.
units.action_summary: Manufacturers must maintain and allow access to sales, shipping, and distribution records identifying purchasers, product type, quantity sold, and sale/shipment dates, and make them available per §1002.31.

units.obligation_text: The provisions of this section and § 1040.11 are applicable to a manufacturer of a laser product and are not applicable as specified to a manufacturer who incorporates such laser product manufactured or assembled after August 1, 1976, into another product, when:
units.actor: Manufacturer who incorporates a laser product into another product
units.action_summary: Sets conditions under which the section does not apply to a manufacturer who incorporates a certified laser product into another product.
units.modal_raw: are not applicable when / are applicable

units.obligation_text: (ii) The manufacturer of the incorporated laser product certifies such a laser product under § 1010.2 of this chapter,
units.actor: Manufacturer of the incorporated laser product
units.action_summary: The manufacturer of the incorporated laser product must certify the product under §1010.2.

units.obligation_text: (iii) The incorporated laser product is not modified as defined in paragraph (i) of this section,
units.action_summary: The incorporated laser product must not be modified as defined in paragraph (i).

units.obligation_text: (iv) The incorporated laser product is installed in accordance with the instructions for the incorporated laser product as provided by the manufacturer of the incorporated laser product,
units.actor: Manufacturer of the incorporating product / installer
units.action_summary: The incorporated laser product must be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions for that incorporated product.

units.obligation_text: (v) The manufacturer of the incorporating product provides with the incorporating product the user information required under paragraph (h) of this section,
units.action_summary: The incorporating product's manufacturer must provide the user information required under paragraph (h) with the incorporating product.

units.obligation_text: (vi) The labeling requirements of §§ 1010.3 of this chapter and 1040.10(g) for the incorporated laser product would be met when the incorporated laser product is removed from the incorporating product,
units.actor: Manufacturer of the incorporating product / manufacturer of incorporated product

units.obligation_text: The packaging of the food remains in place until the food reaches the consumer, and such packaging maintains the integrity of the product and prevents subsequent contamination or alteration of the product.
units.action_summary: Packaging must stay in place until consumer and must preserve product integrity and prevent contamination/alteration for the exemption to apply.

units.obligation_text: The labeling of the food that reaches the consumer includes the name, complete address (street address, town, State, country, and zip or other postal code for a domestic farm and comparable information for a foreign farm), and business phone number of the farm on which the food was produced and packaged.
units.action_summary: Labels reaching consumers must include farm name, full address, and business phone number for the exemption.

units.obligation_text: Upon request, FDA will waive the requirement to include a business phone number, as appropriate, to accommodate a religious belief of the individual in charge of the farm.
units.action_summary: FDA may waive the labeling business phone number requirement upon request to accommodate a religious belief.

units.obligation_text: This subpart does not apply to produce that receives commercial processing that adequately reduces the presence of microorganisms of public health significance, provided the conditions set forth in § 112.2(b) of this chapter are met for the produce.
units.actor: produce that receives qualifying commercial processing
units.action_summary: Produce that receives adequate commercial processing (meeting §112.2(b)) is exempt from this subpart.

units.obligation_text: This subpart does not apply to shell eggs when all eggs produced at the particular farm receive a treatment (as defined in § 118.3 of this chapter) in accordance with § 118.1(a)(2) of this chapter.
units.actor: shell eggs at farms when all eggs receive required treatment
units.action_summary: Shell eggs that receive the specified treatment are exempt from this subpart.

units.obligation_text: This subpart does not apply to produce that is listed as rarely consumed raw in § 112.2(a)(1) of this chapter.
units.actor: produce listed as rarely consumed raw
units.action_summary: Produce designated as rarely consumed raw is exempt from this subpart.

units.obligation_text: Except as specified in paragraph (f)(2) of this section, this subpart does not apply to commingled raw agricultural commodities.
units.action_summary: Commingled raw agricultural commodities are generally exempt from this subpart except as provided in (f)(2).

units.obligation_text: With respect to a commingled raw agricultural commodity that receives the exemption set forth in paragraph (f)(1) of this section, if a person who manufactures, processes, packs, or holds such commingled raw agricultural commodity is required to register with FDA under section 415 ... such person must maintain records identifying the immediate previous source of such raw agricultural commodity and the immediate subsequent recipient of such food in accordance with §§ 1.337 and 1.345.
units.actor: persons who manufacture, process, pack, or hold commingled raw agricultural commodities and are required to register with FDA under section 415
units.action_summary: Registered persons handling commingled raw agricultural commodities must keep records identifying immediate previous source and immediate subsequent recipient per §§1.337 and 1.345.

units.obligation_text: Such records must be maintained for 2 years.
units.actor: persons required to maintain records under § 1.1305(f)(2)
units.action_summary: Records identifying sources and recipients must be kept for two years.

units.obligation_text: This subpart does not apply to retail food establishments that employ 10 or fewer full-time equivalent employees.
units.actor: retail food establishments that employ 10 or fewer full-time equivalent employees
units.action_summary: Small retail food establishments (≤10 FTE employees) are exempt from the subpart under Option 1.

units.obligation_text: The requirement in § 1.1455(b)(3) to make available to FDA under specified circumstances an electronic sortable spreadsheet ... does not apply to retail food establishments that employ 10 or fewer full-time equivalent employees.
units.actor: retail food establishments that employ 10 or fewer full-time equivalent employees
units.action_summary: Under Option 2, small retail establishments (≤10 FTE) are exempt from the §1.1455(b)(3) spreadsheet availability requirement.

units.obligation_text: Except as specified in paragraph (h)(2) of this section, the recordkeeping requirements of this subpart do not apply to a retail food establishment with respect to a food that is produced on a farm (including food produced and packaged on the farm) and sold directly to the retail food establishment by the owner, operator, or agent in charge of that farm.
units.actor: retail food establishments (with respect to foods purchased directly from a farm owner/operator/agent)
units.action_summary: Retail food establishments are exempt from recordkeeping requirements when they buy food directly from a farm owner/operator/agent, except as provided in (h)(2).

units.obligation_text: When a retail food establishment purchases a food on the Food Traceability List directly from a farm ... the retail food establishment must establish and maintain a record documenting the name and address of the farm that was the source of the food.
units.actor: retail food establishment that purchases directly from a farm
units.action_summary: Retailers buying directly from a farm must keep a record documenting the farm's name and address.

units.obligation_text: The retail food establishment must maintain such records for 180 days.
units.actor: retail food establishment that purchases directly from a farm
units.action_summary: Retailers must retain the farm source records for 180 days.

units.obligation_text: Except as specified in paragraph (i)(2) of this section, this subpart does not apply to an institution operating a child nutrition program ... with respect to a food that is produced on a farm ... and sold directly to the school or institution.
units.actor: institutions operating child nutrition programs or entities conducting farm-to-school/farm-to-institution programs (with respect to foods purchased directly from a farm)
units.action_summary: Schools/institutions in farm-to-school or similar programs are exempt for foods purchased directly from a farm, except as provided in (i)(2).

units.obligation_text: When a school or institution conducting farm to school or farm to institution activities purchases a food directly from a farm ... the school food authority or relevant food procurement entity must establish and maintain a record documenting the name and address of the farm that was the source of the food.
units.actor: school food authority or relevant food procurement entity
units.action_summary: Schools/institutions that buy directly from farms must record the farm's name and address.

units.obligation_text: The school food authority or relevant food procurement entity must maintain such records for 180 days.
units.actor: school food authority or relevant food procurement entity
units.action_summary: These records must be kept for 180 days.

units.obligation_text: Except as specified in paragraph (j)(2) of this section, with respect to a food that is produced through the use of a fishing vessel, this subpart does not apply to the owner, operator, or agent in charge of the fishing vessel.
units.actor: owner, operator, or agent in charge of a fishing vessel (with respect to food produced via that vessel)
units.action_summary: Owners/operators/agents of fishing vessels are generally exempt for foods produced via the vessel, subject to (j)(2).

units.obligation_text: With respect to the owner, operator, or agent in charge of the fishing vessel who receives the partial exemption set forth in paragraph (j)(1) of this section, if such person is required to register with FDA under section 415 ... such person must maintain records identifying the immediate previous source of such food and the immediate subsequent recipient of such food in accordance with §§ 1.337 and 1.345.
units.actor: owners/operators/agents of fishing vessels who are required to register with FDA under section 415
units.action_summary: Registered fishing vessel operators must maintain records identifying immediate previous source and immediate subsequent recipient per specified sections.

units.obligation_text: Such records must be maintained for 2 years.
units.actor: owners/operators/agents of fishing vessels required to maintain records under § 1.1305(j)(2)
units.action_summary: These records must be kept for two years.

units.obligation_text: This subpart does not apply to transporters of food.
units.action_summary: Transporters are exempt from this subpart.

units.obligation_text: This subpart does not apply to nonprofit food establishments.
units.action_summary: Nonprofit food establishments are exempt from this subpart.

units.obligation_text: This subpart does not apply to persons who manufacture, process, pack, or hold food for personal consumption.
units.actor: persons who manufacture/process/pack/hold food for personal consumption
units.action_summary: Personal-consumption food activities are exempt from this subpart.

units.obligation_text: This subpart does not apply to persons who hold food on behalf of specific individual consumers, provided that these persons: (1) Are not parties to the transaction involving the food they hold; and (2) Are not in the business of distributing food.
units.actor: persons who hold food on behalf of specific individual consumers (subject to conditions)
units.action_summary: Persons holding food on behalf of specific individual consumers are exempt provided they are not parties to the transaction and are not in the business of distributing food.

units.obligation_text: Are not parties to the transaction involving the food they hold;
units.action_summary: To qualify for the exemption, the holder must not be a party to the transaction for the food.

units.obligation_text: Are not in the business of distributing food.
units.action_summary: To qualify for the exemption, the holder must not be in the business of distributing food.

units.obligation_text: If you are subject to the requirements in this subpart, you must establish and maintain records containing the following information:
units.action_summary: Entities subject to the subpart must keep specific traceability program records.

units.obligation_text: A description of the reference records in which you maintain the information required under this subpart, an explanation of where on the records the required information appears, and, if applicable, a description of how reference records for different tracing events for a food ... are linked;
units.action_summary: Keep a description of reference records, where required information appears, and how records are linked.

units.obligation_text: A list of foods on the Food Traceability List that you ship, including the traceability product identifier and traceability product description for each food;
units.action_summary: Maintain a list of shipped Food Traceability List items including product identifiers and descriptions.

units.obligation_text: A description of how you establish and assign traceability lot codes to foods on the Food Traceability List you originate, transform, or create, if applicable;
units.action_summary: Document procedures for establishing and assigning traceability lot codes for relevant foods.

units.obligation_text: Any other information needed to understand the data provided within any records required by this subpart, such as internal or external coding systems, glossaries, and abbreviations.
units.action_summary: Provide additional explanatory information (codes, glossaries, abbreviations) needed to understand records.

units.obligation_text: You must retain the records required under paragraph (a) of this section for 2 years after their use is discontinued ...
units.action_summary: Retain the required traceability program records for two years after their use is discontinued.

units.obligation_text: You must establish and assign a traceability lot code when you originate, transform, or create a food on the Food Traceability List.
units.actor: persons who originate, transform, or create foods on the Food Traceability List
units.action_summary: Assign a traceability lot code at the time of origination, transformation, or creation of a listed food.

units.obligation_text: Except as specified otherwise in this subpart, you may not establish a new traceability lot code when you conduct other activities (e.g., shipping, receiving) in the supply chain for a food on the Food Traceability List.
units.actor: persons handling foods on the Food Traceability List
units.action_summary: You are prohibited from creating new traceability lot codes for activities other than origination, transformation, or creation (absent exceptions).

units.obligation_text: For each food on the Food Traceability List that you grow, you must establish and maintain records containing and linking the traceability lot code of the food to the following information:
units.actor: growers of foods on the Food Traceability List
units.action_summary: Growers must keep records linking traceability lot codes to specified growing information.

units.obligation_text: The growing area coordinates;
units.actor: growers of foods on the Food Traceability List
units.action_summary: Record the GPS or latitude/longitude coordinates for the growing area.

units.obligation_text: For growers of sprouts, the following information (if applicable):
units.action_summary: Sprout growers must maintain specific seed- and lot-related records as listed.

units.obligation_text: The location identifier and location description of the grower of seeds for sprouting, the associated seed lot code assigned by the seed grower, and the date of seed harvesting;
units.action_summary: Record seed grower location identifier/description, seed lot code, and seed harvest date.

units.obligation_text: The location identifier and location description of the seed conditioner or processor, the associated seed lot code assigned by the seed conditioner or processor, and the date of conditioning or processing;
units.action_summary: Record seed conditioner/processor location identifier/description, seed lot code assigned by them, and conditioning/processing date.

units.obligation_text: The location identifier and location description of the seed packinghouse (including any repackers, if applicable), the associated seed lot code assigned by the seed packinghouse, and the date of packing (and of repacking, if applicable);
units.action_summary: Record seed packinghouse location identifier/description, seed lot code assigned by packinghouse, and packing/repacking date.

units.obligation_text: The location identifier and location description of the seed supplier;
units.action_summary: Record seed supplier location identifier and description.

units.obligation_text: A description of the seeds, including the seed type or taxonomic name, growing specifications, volume, type of packaging, and antimicrobial treatment;
units.action_summary: Document seed descriptions including type, specs, volume, packaging, and antimicrobial treatments.

units.obligation_text: The seed lot code assigned by the seed supplier, including the master lot and sub-lot codes, and any new seed lot code assigned by the sprouter;
units.action_summary: Record seed supplier lot codes (master/sub-lot) and any new seed lot codes assigned by the sprouter.

units.obligation_text: The date of receipt of the seeds by the sprouter;
units.action_summary: Record date seeds were received by the sprouter.

units.obligation_text: For each lot code for seeds received by the sprouter, the sprout traceability lot code(s) and the date(s) of production associated with that seed lot code.
units.action_summary: Link each received seed lot code to sprout traceability lot codes and production dates.

units.obligation_text: Except as specified in paragraph (b) of this section, in addition to the records of receipt of foods required under § 1.1335, the first receiver of a food on the Food Traceability List must establish and maintain records containing and linking the traceability lot code of the food received to the following information:
units.actor: first receivers of foods on the Food Traceability List
units.action_summary: First receivers must keep records linking traceability lot codes to specified origin, harvester, cooling, and packing information (per items 1-4).

units.obligation_text: The location identifier and location description of the originator of the food;
units.action_summary: Record the originator's location identifier and description.

units.obligation_text: The business name, point of contact, and phone number of the harvester of the food, and the date(s) and time(s) of harvesting;
units.action_summary: Record harvester business name, point of contact, phone number, and harvest date(s)/time(s).

units.obligation_text: The location identifier and location description of the place where the food was cooled, and the date and time of cooling (if applicable);
units.action_summary: Record cooling location identifier/description and cooling date/time when applicable.

units.obligation_text: The location identifier and location description of the place where the food was packed, and the date and time of packing.
units.action_summary: Record packing location identifier/description and packing date/time.

units.obligation_text: If you are the first receiver of a seafood product on the Food Traceability List that was obtained from a fishing vessel ... in addition to the records of receipt ... you must establish and maintain records ... linked to the harvest date range and locations (National Marine Fisheries Service Ocean Geographic Code or geographical coordinates) for the trip during which the seafood was caught.
units.actor: first receivers of seafood obtained from a fishing vessel
units.action_summary: First receivers of vessel-caught seafood must record harvest date range and trip locations (NMFS codes or coordinates).

units.obligation_text: If you are the first receiver of a food on the Food Traceability List to which the originator of the food has not assigned a traceability lot code, you must establish a traceability lot code for the food and maintain a record of the traceability lot code linked to the information specified in paragraph (a) or (b) of this section (as applicable to the type of food received).
units.actor: first receivers when originator has not assigned a traceability lot code
units.action_summary: If originator didn't assign a traceability lot code, the first receiver must assign one and link it to required information.

units.obligation_text: For each food on the Food Traceability List you receive, you must establish and maintain records containing and linking the traceability lot code of the food to the following information:
units.actor: persons who receive foods on the Food Traceability List
units.action_summary: Receivers must keep records linking traceability lot codes to specified source, entry, receipt location/time, quantity, product identifiers/descriptions, lot code generator contact, reference records, and transporter name.

units.obligation_text: The location identifier and location description for the immediate previous source (other than a transporter) of the food;
units.action_summary: Record the immediate previous source's location identifier and description (excluding transporter).

units.obligation_text: The entry number(s) assigned to the food (if the food is imported);
units.action_summary: Record import entry number(s) for imported foods.

units.obligation_text: The location identifier and location description of where the food was received, and date and time you received the food;
units.action_summary: Record where and when the food was received (location identifier/description and date/time).

units.obligation_text: The quantity and unit of measure of the food (e.g., 6 cases, 25 returnable plastic containers, 100 tanks, 200 pounds);
units.action_summary: Record the quantity and unit of measure for the received food.

units.obligation_text: The traceability product identifier and traceability product description for the food;
units.action_summary: Record the traceability product identifier and product description.

units.obligation_text: The location identifier, location description, and point of contact for the traceability lot code generator;
units.action_summary: Record the lot code generator's location identifier, description, and point of contact.

units.obligation_text: The reference record type(s) and reference record number(s) ... for the document(s) containing the information specified in paragraphs (a) through (f) of this section;
units.action_summary: Record the types and numbers of reference documents (e.g., invoice, BOL) that contain required information.

units.obligation_text: The name of the transporter who transported the food to you.
units.action_summary: Record the transporter name for the food delivery.

units.obligation_text: Except as specified in paragraph (b) of this section, for each new traceability lot of food produced through transformation you must establish and maintain records containing and linking the new traceability lot code of the food produced through transformation to the following information:
units.actor: persons who transform foods on the Food Traceability List
units.action_summary: For each new traceability lot produced by transformation, maintain records linking the new lot code to specified input and output information.

units.obligation_text: For the food(s) on the Food Traceability List used in transformation, the following information: (i) The traceability lot code(s) for the food; (ii) The traceability product identifier and traceability product description for the food to which the traceability lot code applies; and (iii) The quantity of each traceability lot of the food.
units.action_summary: Record input foods' traceability lot codes, product identifiers/descriptions, and quantities used in the transformation.

units.obligation_text: The traceability lot code(s) for the food;
units.action_summary: Record the traceability lot codes for input foods used in the transformation.

units.obligation_text: The traceability product identifier and traceability product description for the food to which the traceability lot code applies;
units.action_summary: Record the product identifier and description for each input lot code.

units.obligation_text: The quantity of each traceability lot of the food.
units.action_summary: Record the quantity and unit of measure for each input traceability lot used.

units.obligation_text: For the food produced through transformation, the following information: (i) The location identifier and location description for where you transformed the food ... and the date transformation was completed; (ii) The new traceability product identifier and traceability product description for the food to which the new traceability lot code applies; and (iii) The quantity and unit of measure of the food for each new traceability lot code ...
units.action_summary: Record transformation site/location and completion date, new product identifier/description, and quantity/unit for each new traceability lot.

units.obligation_text: The location identifier and location description for where you transformed the food (e.g., by a manufacturing/processing step), and the date transformation was completed;
units.action_summary: Record where the transformation occurred and the date it was completed.

units.obligation_text: The new traceability product identifier and traceability product description for the food to which the new traceability lot code applies;
units.action_summary: Record the new product identifier and description associated with the new traceability lot code.

units.obligation_text: The quantity and unit of measure of the food for each new traceability lot code (e.g., 6 cases, 25 returnable plastic containers, 100 tanks, 200 pounds).
units.action_summary: Record the quantity and unit of measure for each new traceability lot code produced by transformation.

title:
Requirements for Additional Traceability Records for Certain
Foods; Proposed Rule; Public Meetings; Request for Comments
Requirements for Additional Traceability Records for Certain Foods; Extension of Comment Period; Reopening of the Comment Period

units.obligation_text: Submit either electronic or written comments on the proposed rule by February 22, 2021
units.action_summary: Commenters must submit electronic or written comments on the proposed rule by February 22, 2021.

units.obligation_text: Submit comments on information collection issues under the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 (PRA) by February 22, 2021
units.action_summary: Commenters must submit PRA-related comments by February 22, 2021.

units.obligation_text: Electronic comments must be submitted on or before February 22, 2021
units.action_summary: Comments submitted electronically must be submitted on or before February 22, 2021.

units.obligation_text: The https://www.regulations.gov electronic filing system will accept comments until 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time at the end of February 22, 2021
units.action_summary: The regulations.gov system will accept electronic comments through 11:59 p.m. ET on Feb 22, 2021.

units.obligation_text: Comments received by mail/hand delivery/courier (for written/paper submissions) will be considered timely if they are postmarked or the delivery service acceptance receipt is on or before that date
units.action_summary: Written/paper comments are timely if postmarked or have delivery service acceptance receipt on or before Feb 22, 2021.

units.obligation_text: Please note that late, untimely filed comments will not be considered
units.action_summary: Comments submitted after the deadline will not be considered.

units.obligation_text: To ensure that comments on the information collection are received, OMB recommends that written comments be submitted to https://www.reginfo.gov/public/do/PRAMain
units.action_summary: OMB recommends submitting written comments on information collection to reginfo.gov.

units.obligation_text: All submissions received must include the Docket No. FDA-2014-N-0053 for "Requirements for Additional Traceability Records for Certain Foods."
units.action_summary: All submissions must include the docket number FDA-2014-N-0053.

units.obligation_text: If you want to submit a comment with confidential information that you do not wish to be made available to the public, submit the comment as a written/paper submission
units.action_summary: Commenters who want to keep information confidential must submit comments as written/paper submissions.

units.obligation_text: To submit a comment with confidential information ... submit the comment as a written/paper submission. You should submit two copies total
units.action_summary: Submit two paper copies when providing confidential information: one with confidential information and one redacted.

units.obligation_text: One copy will include the information you claim to be confidential with a heading or cover note that states "THIS DOCUMENT CONTAINS CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION."
units.action_summary: One of the two copies must include the claimed confidential information and a heading stating it contains confidential information.

units.obligation_text: The second copy, which will have the claimed confidential information redacted/blacked out, will be available for public viewing and posted on https://www.regulations.gov
units.action_summary: Submit a second redacted copy for public viewing; FDA will post the redacted copy on regulations.gov.

units.obligation_text: Submit both copies to the Dockets Management Staff
units.action_summary: Both copies (one confidential, one redacted) must be submitted to the Dockets Management Staff.

units.obligation_text: If you do not wish your name and contact information to be made publicly available, you can provide this information on the cover sheet and not in the body of your comments and you must identify this information as "confidential."
units.action_summary: To keep name/contact info private, provide it on the cover sheet and identify it as "confidential."

units.obligation_text: Any information marked as "confidential" will not be disclosed except in accordance with 21 CFR 10.20 and other applicable disclosure law
units.action_summary: Information marked confidential will generally not be disclosed except as allowed by law (21 CFR 10.20 etc.).

units.obligation_text: Received comments, those filed in a timely manner (see ADDRESSES), will be placed in the docket and, except for those submitted as "Confidential Submissions," publicly viewable at https://www.regulations.gov or at the Dockets Management Staff between 9 a.m. and 4 p.m., Monday through Friday, 240-402-7500
units.action_summary: Timely filed comments will be placed in the docket and made publicly viewable, except confidential submissions.

title: Regulations Regarding Intended Uses

units.obligation_text: such packer, distributor, or seller is required to supply adequate labeling in accordance with the new intended uses.
units.action_summary: Supply adequate labeling consistent with the new intended uses when they intend different uses.

units.obligation_text: If, for example, a packer, distributor, or seller intends an article for different uses than those intended by the person from whom he or she received the article,
units.action_summary: Condition describing when the labeling requirement applies (when the packer/distributor/seller intends different uses).

units.obligation_text: a firm would not be regarded as intending an unapproved new use for an approved drug based solely on that firm’s knowledge that such drug was being prescribed or used by health care providers for such use.
units.action_summary: A firm is not to be considered as intending an unapproved new use for an approved drug solely because it knows health care providers are prescribing or using the drug for that use.

units.obligation_text: such packer, distributor, or seller is required to supply adequate labeling in accordance with the new intended uses.
units.action_summary: Supply adequate labeling consistent with the new intended uses when they intend different uses.

units.obligation_text: If, for example, a packer, distributor, or seller intends an article for different uses than those intended by the person from whom he or she received the article,
units.action_summary: Condition describing when the labeling requirement applies (when the packer/distributor/seller intends different uses).

units.obligation_text: a firm would not be regarded as intending an unapproved new use for an approved or cleared device based solely on that firm’s knowledge that such device was being prescribed or used by health care providers for such use.
